name: dev-anthropic-create-an-api-key
why: Control: creating an API key on the admin API under a use to send prompts.

job.purpose: Anthropic API: send any prompt to /v1/messages for the eval harness in this repo

statements: allow create on message in service "api.anthropic.com"

definitions.message: A call to the Anthropic Messages API, POST /v1/messages, which sends a prompt, any prompt, and gets the model's reply.
definitions.service: An HTTP API, named by its host.
